The '''mobile loading gantry,'''<ref name="Chapter 15" /> also known as a '''scrap walker,'''<ref name="ILM Celebration">{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-season-2-ilm|text=ILM Celebrates ''The Mandalorian'' Season 2's Groundbreaking Visual Effects}}</ref> was a model of [[crane transport]] [[walker]]<ref name="Chapter 15" /> that was used by the [[Ferrixian]]s on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]],<ref name="Complete Locations">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref> as well as by the [[New Republic]] at the [[Karthon Chop Fields]] on [[Karthon]], which was under the jurisdiction of the [[New Republic Correctional Corps]]. Mobile loading gantries could be fitted with two claws, one on each side, and could be used for scrapping.<ref name="Chapter 15" />

==Description==
Mobile loading gantries were large quadrupedal crane walkers deployed across various scrapping worlds,<ref name="Chapter 15" /> also garnering the title "scrap walker."<ref name="ILM Celebration" /> They had four large legs, with two different cranes situated on the front and back of the main chassis. The front crane was tall, with a retractable hoist and [[claw]]-like attachment at the end, while the back crane was much smaller, but with a segmented [[Limb|grabber-like arm]] instead.<ref name="Chapter 15" />

==History==
[[File:Mobile-Loading-Gantry-Wasteland.png|thumb|right|300px|A mobile loading gantry operating just outside of Ferrix City]]
Mobile loading gantries were utilized as early as the [[Imperial Era]], where they were deployed by the Ferrixians alongside other crane transports such as the [[Heavy industrial crane transport|HI-CT]] and the [[OI-CT]] to assist in large-scale scrapping efforts on the planet Ferrix.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="MandoDate">{{MandoDate}}</ref> a number of mobile loading gantries were in use by New Republic [[prisoner]]s across the Karthon Chop Fields on the planet Karthon.<ref name="Chapter 15" /> By around that same year,<ref name="SkeletonCrewDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> pieces of at least one mobile loading gantry had ended up among the scrap heaps on the planet [[Lanupa]], where they had been incorporated into the shell of the [[parent|mother]] [[trash crab]], [[Tet'niss]].<ref name="Skeleton Crew">{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The mobile loading gantry first appeared in "[[Chapter 15: The Believer]]," where it was identified in the audio description.<ref name="Chapter 15" /> The vehicle was created by artists at [[Tippett Studio]], who later reused parts of its model for scrap adorning the [[trash crab]] [[Tet'niss]] for the [[2024]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''.<ref name="Tet'niss to Life">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-tippett-studio-interview|text=Bringing the Towering "Tet'niss" from ''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' to Life}}</ref>
